Q687.reason: T false and U, W, X true makes all three formulas true, while T and U false makes (T ⊃ U) ⊃ (W ⊃ U) false.

Q616.reason: “No senior graduates without a major” is the universal negative (∀x)(Sx ⊃ ~Gx); (∀x)(~Sx ⊃ ~Gx) only says non-seniors do not graduate.

Q608.reason: E sufficient for F is E ⊃ F, and C necessary for S is S ⊃ C, so the sentence is (E ⊃ F) ∨ (S ⊃ C).
